final_lock_trigger: Final article framing, final figure/table set and claim hierarchy are locked.
missing_before_submission: Final article framing and final figure/table set.
forbidden_final_wording: Do not imply a finished submission package while figures, validation and repository gates remain open.

final_lock_trigger: Final asset inclusion/exclusion table, licence boundaries and sample counts are locked.
missing_before_submission: Final inclusion/exclusion criteria and third-party licence boundaries for each asset.
forbidden_final_wording: Do not count TIGPR as an executable core asset while local sample rows remain zero.

final_lock_trigger: Frozen split manifests, seed table and final figure source-data mapping are complete.
missing_before_submission: Frozen split manifests and exact seed table for every final figure.
forbidden_final_wording: Do not state that all final splits are frozen before final figure/source-data lock.

final_lock_trigger: A real external asset passes strict SHA intake, labels are held outside the analyst workflow and predictions are frozen before label unlock.
missing_before_submission: Real external asset, strict-SHA manifest, label holdout, frozen prediction submission, label unlock and one-shot locked evaluation.
forbidden_final_wording: Do not write completed blinding or blind validation from protocol templates or dry runs.

final_lock_trigger: Final metric list, uncertainty policy, tests if any, and multiple-comparison policy are locked.
missing_before_submission: Final uncertainty interval policy, final statistical test plan and multiple-comparison policy if inferential tests are added.
forbidden_final_wording: Do not imply inferential testing, uncertainty intervals or multiple-comparison correction unless actually added.

final_lock_trigger: Public repository URL, release tag, software licence and archive DOI exist.
missing_before_submission: Public repository URL, release tag, archive DOI, software licence and final figure-generation backend.
forbidden_final_wording: Do not write public code repository, release tag or code DOI until they exist.

final_lock_trigger: Data repository DOI/accession, README, licence, final Source Data and rights review are complete.
missing_before_submission: Repository DOI/accession, dataset README, licence, final source-data mapping and third-party data source citations.
forbidden_final_wording: Do not write data DOI, full public data availability or all-data-in-paper until source data, licence and rights are closed.

final_lock_trigger: One locked evaluation is run after label unlock, or the manuscript explicitly preserves external validation as an open gate.
missing_before_submission: Acquire or restore a separate blind external asset and run the locked evaluation after label unlock.
forbidden_final_wording: Do not write completed external validation without held labels, frozen predictions and one locked evaluation.
